purpose: Complete source dialogue evidence for blocked native and exchange branches; not a second handler.

literal_parts: You can buy different equipment for minor or for major tokens. So, which is the equipment you are interested in, the one for {minor} or {major} tokens? ...
By the way, if you want to have a look on the prismatic and gill items first, just head over to the depot and check the market.

For ten major tokens, I can offer you a {gill gugel}, a {gill coat}, {gill legs}, a {spellbook} of vigilance, a {prismatic helmet}, a {prismatic armor}, {prismatic legs}, {prismatic boots} or a {prismatic shield} ...
For twenty major tokens, I can offer you a {basic soil guardian outfit}, a {basic crystal warlord outfit}, an {iron loadstone} or a {glow wine}.

For two minor tokens, you can buy one gnomish {supply} package! For eight tokens, you can buy a {muck} remover! For ten tokens, you can buy a {mission} crystal. For fifteen tokens, you can buy a crystal {lamp} or a mushroom {backpack}. ...
For seventy tokens, I can offer you a voucher for an {addition to the soil guardian outfit}, or a voucher for an {addition to the crystal warlord armor outfit}.
Do you want to trade %s %s for %d %s tokens?
Our relations improve with every mission you undertake on our behalf. Another way to improve your relations with us gnomes is to trade in minor crystal tokens. ...
Your renown amongst us gnomes is currently {
}. Do you want to improve your standing by sacrificing tokens? One token will raise your renown by 5 points.
You are not even a recruit of the Bigfoots. Sorry I can't help you.
Do you really want to trade
minor tokens for
renown?
Do you need to buy any mission items?
Sorry, you don't have enough
tokens with you.
First make sure you have enough capacity to hold it.
First make sure you have enough space in your inventory.
Here have one of our
How many tokens do you want to trade?
As you wish! Your new renown is {
You don't have these many tokens.
Let us see if I have what you need.
As you like.
Oh, hello! I'm the gnome-human relations assistant. I am here for you to trade your tokens for {equipment}, resupply you with mission {items} and talk to you about your {relations} to us gnomes! ...
Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
Your examination is quite easy. Just step through the green crystal apparatus in the south! We will examine you with what we call g-rays. Where g stands for gnome of course ...
Afterwards walk up to Gnomedix for your ear examination.
I provide the population with some fresh alcohol-free mushroom {beer}!
Do you want some mushroom beer for 10 gold?
Don't be afraid. It won't hurt! Just step in!
And here it is! Drink it quick, it gets stale quite fast!
You do not have enough money.
Come back later.
Hi there! Welcome to my little {tavern}.
I suggest you relax a bit with a fresh mushroom beer and we can talk after that. ...
Gnominus... He is the one you need right now, find him.
Yes... Yes... <sigh>. We already talked about that. I can't remember if you have already tried the {test}, so lets get going.
We are hiring people to fight in our so called Bigfoot company against the foes of gnomekind. Are you interested in joining?
Imagine, during your travels you come upon a rare and unknown mushroom. Would you {A}) note down its specifics and location and look for a gnome to take care of it. ...

Or would you {B}) smash it to an unrecognisable pulp. Or would you {C}) pluck it to take it with you for further examination. Or would you {D}) try to become friends with the mushroom by singing questionable bar-room songs?
Imagine you wake up one morning and discover you have forgotten how to knot your shoelaces. Would you {A}) admit defeat and go to bed once more. ...
{B}) look for a gnome that can remind you how to do it. {C}) Despite the risk of injuring yourself, try to figure it out on your own. {D}) Use some pottery instead of shoes.
Now let us assume you see a gnome in danger. Would you {A}) not care because you must be imagining things. {B}) Save the gnome despite all odds and risk to your own life. ...
{C}) Inspire the gnome by singing the gnomish national anthem. {D}) Hide and loot his corpse if he dies.
Imagine you were participating in a gnome-throwing competition. Would you {A}) do some physical calculations in advance to increase your chances of winning. ...
{B}) throw the gnome as safely as you can to ensure his safety. {C}) Sabotage the throwing gnomes of your competitors. {D}) Never participate in such an abominable competition.
Now imagine you were given the order to guard a valuable and unique mushroom. You guard it for days and no one shows up to release you and you grow hungry. ...
Would you {A}) eat your boots. {B}) eat the mushroom. {C}) eat a bit of the mushroom. {D}) stick to your duty and continue starving.
What do you think describes gnomish society best? {A}) Ingenuity {B}) Bravery {C}) Humility {D}) All of the above.

How many bigfoot does it take to change a light crystal? {A}) Only one since it's a piece of mushroom cake. {B}) Light crystals are delicate products of gnomish science and should only be handled by certified gnomish experts. ...

{C}) Three. One to hold the crystal and two to turn him around. {D}) Five. A light crystal turner, a light crystal picker, a light crystal exchanger, a light crystal changing manager and finally a light crystal changing manager assistant.
What is a pollyfluxed quantumresonator? {A}) Something funny. {B}) Something important. {C}) Something to be destroyed. ...
{D}) Sadly I am not a gnome and lack the intelligence and education to know about even the simplest of gnomish inventions.
If your mushroom patch is infested with cave worms, would you {A}) place some green light crystals to drive them away. {B}) place some disharmonic crystals to drive them away. ...
{C}) burn everything down. {D}) switch your diet to cave worms.
What is the front part of a spear? Is it {A}) the pointed one. {B}) The blunt one. {C}) Whatever causes the most damage {D}) A spear is no weapon but a fruit that grows on surface trees.
On a military campaign what piece of equipment would you need most? ...

Is it {A}) some tasty mushroom beer to keep the morale high. {B}) A large backpack to carry all the loot. {C}) A mighty weapon to vanquish the foes. {D}) Mushroom earplugs to be spared of the cries of agony of your opponents?
What comes first? {A}) safety {B}) I {C}) duty {D}) George
In case of emergency {A}) break glass {B}) break a leg {C}) have a break {D}) call a gnome?
The greatest disaster I can imagine is ... {A}) to fail the gnomes {B}) a ruined mushroom pie {C}) accidentally hammering my finger {D}) having some work to do
What would your favourite pet be? {A}) A Krazzelzak of course. {B}) An Uxmoff to be honest. {C}) Montpiffs were always my favourite. {D}) A Humdrella and nothing else!
Why do you want to become a bigfoot? {A}) To become rich and famous. {B}) To become famous and rich. {C}) To become rich or famous. {D}) To serve the gnomish community in their struggle?
Indeed an excellent and smart decision for an ungnomish lifeform. But let us continue with the {test}.
A well thought out answer I have to admit. But let us continue with the {test}.
Ah, we have a true warrior here I guess. But let us continue with the {test}.
Fear not. We don't expect too much of you anyway. But let us continue with the {test}.
Ha! A Krazzelzak would for sure fit someone like you! But let us continue with the {test}.
Wrong answer!
Stop it! The test is over, you can ask me for your {results}.
Although chances are the gnome will end up rescuing you instead, it is the attempt that counts. But let us continue with the {test}.
I knew this question was too easy. But let us continue with the {test}.
Wrong answer!
Stop it! The test is over, you can ask me for your {results}.
That's the spirit! Initiative is always a good thing. Well most of the time. But let us continue with the {test}.
You have no idea how many answer this question wrong. But let us continue with the {test}.
That's the spirit! But let us continue with the {test}.
Wrong answer!
Stop it! The test is over, you can ask me for your {results}.
Of COURSE you wouldn't! NO ONE would! But let us continue with the {test}.
I can only hope that is your honest opinion. But let us continue with the test.
Oh, you silver tongued devil almost made me blush. But of course you're right. But let us continue with the {test}.
How true. How true. *sigh* But fear not! We gnomes are here to help! But let us continue with the {test}.
That's just what I'd do - if I weren't a gnome already, that is. But let us continue with the {test}.
Excellent! Well this concludes the test. Now let us see your {results}.
Wrong answer!
Stop it! The test is over, you can ask me for your {results}.
You have failed the test with
of 112 possible points. You probably were just too nervous. ...
I suggest you relax a bit with a fresh mushroom beer and we'll start over after that. Gnominus sells some beer. You should find him somewhere in the central chamber.
You have passed the test with
of 112 possible points. Congratulations. You are ready to proceed with the more physical parts of your examination! Go and talk to Gnomespector about it.
Excellent! Now let us begin with the gnomish aptitude test. Just tell me when you feel ready for the {test}!
Hello and welcome in the gnomish {recruitment} office.
